summary: Iteration 4 fully tested (backend + frontend). Backend: 6/6 pytest pass in test_iteration4.py — seeded products expose correct discounts arrays (Ulje Bundeve [0,5,10]/def 5, Kokosovo [0,3,7]/def 0, Jabukovo [0,10,15]/def 10); POST/PUT of `discounts` persist and round-trip; orders correctly store the chosen non-default discount (10% on Ulje Bundeve → line 1.620,00, gross 1.944,00 ✓) and preserve default when untouched. Frontend UI (mobile viewport 390x844): image-zoom-overlay opens on product-image tap and dismisses on overlay tap; discount-dropdown-<id> opens with correct options 0/5/10, selecting discount-option-10 updates discount-value-<id> to 10%; confirm creates order and invoice renders 1.944,00 grand total (chosen discount applied). Admin form supports multi-discount: form-discount-input + form-add-discount adds disc-chip-<v>, tapping a chip sets it as default (star), disc-remove-<v> removes chip, save persists discounts array + default to backend (verified via GET: {discount:15, discounts:[0,15]} for TEST product). send-email-button exists on invoice, clicks without crash (mailto fallback in web preview expected — native MailComposer attachments only run on device). PDF attach in composeAsync is device-only; web-preview fallback is mailto text as designed.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend Product model correctly exposes discounts:List[float] alongside discount:float; PUT and POST both round-trip the array; seed migration back-fills sensible values ({0,default}) for legacy docs so old products keep working (server.py:230-235).

Frontend catalog: discount picker Modal children are properly guarded with `{discountPickerFor && (...)}` (index.tsx:389). Confirmed no crash when the modal opens/closes; also verified image zoom Modal renders and dismisses cleanly.
Order confirmation correctly uses `discountSel[p.id] ?? p.discount ?? 0` so an unchanged dropdown sends the product default while a chosen value overrides it (index.tsx:118).

Admin form (admin.tsx:165-183) correctly manages the chips list, promotes first-added chip to default automatically, keeps `discount` in-sync when the default chip is removed by falling back to next[0] ?? 0, and prevents duplicate values.
